prompt.zh-TW: 青田農產今年營業收入 {{money:vars.revenue}}，本期淨利 {{money:vars.ni}}。計算純益率（Excel 口徑），以百分比作答。
prompt.en: Green Field Produce had revenue of {{money:vars.revenue}} and profit for the period of {{money:vars.ni}} this year. What is the net profit margin (Excel basis)? Answer as a percentage.

explanation.zh-TW: {{term:tm_92yzx0fn}}＝{{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}} ÷ {{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}}，回答「每一元營收最後留下多少淨利」。它是杜邦拆解的第一個因子，也是損益表從上到下扣完所有項目後的結果。
explanation.en: {{term:tm_92yzx0fn}} = {{term:tm_n4e8t2jy}} ÷ {{term:tm_v3n8q2ye}}: how much of each dollar of revenue is left as profit. It is the first factor of the DuPont breakdown and the result of working all the way down the income statement.
